tooltip.greenlantern.ring.hold: Hold in either hand, or wear it in a Curios ring slot.
tooltip.greenlantern.ring.tree: Open the powers menu to upgrade it with XP.
tooltip.greenlantern.battery.1: Hold it in your main hand (ring in your other hand
tooltip.greenlantern.battery.2: or a ring slot) and press Recharge to fully charge it.
ability.greenlantern.uniform.description: Toggle your corps' suit on or off. Pick the suit and mask in the accessories menu.
ability.greenlantern.skill_health_1.desc: +10 hearts while your ring is charged. Costs 5 XP levels.
ability.greenlantern.skill_health_2.desc: Another +10 hearts while your ring is charged. Costs 15 XP levels.
ability.greenlantern.skill_combat_1.desc: +4 attack and punch damage while your ring is charged. Costs 5 XP levels.
ability.greenlantern.skill_combat_2.desc: Another +4 attack and punch damage. Costs 15 XP levels.
ability.greenlantern.skill_charge_1.desc: Your ring holds 1500 charge instead of 1000. Costs 5 XP levels.
ability.greenlantern.skill_charge_2.desc: Your ring holds 2000 charge. Costs 15 XP levels.
ability.greenlantern.skill_flight.descri: Fly on the power of your ring, leaving a trail of light. Flying slowly drains charge. Costs 5 XP levels.
ability.greenlantern.skill_constructs.de: Unlocks the construct wheel and the Blast construct. Costs 5 XP levels.
ability.greenlantern.skill_fist.descript: Adds the Giant Fist to the construct wheel. Costs 8 XP levels.
ability.greenlantern.skill_cage.descript: Adds the Cage to the construct wheel. Costs 10 XP levels.
ability.greenlantern.skill_slam.descript: Adds the Hammer Slam to the construct wheel. Costs 12 XP levels.
ability.greenlantern.skill_wall.descript: Adds the Wall to the construct wheel. Costs 10 XP levels.
ability.greenlantern.skill_force_field.d: Unlocks a bubble that blocks projectiles, explosions and fire. Costs 5 XP levels.
oath.greenlantern.green.1: In brightest day, in blackest night,
oath.greenlantern.green.2: No evil shall escape my sight.
oath.greenlantern.green.3: Let those who worship evil's might,
oath.greenlantern.green.4: Beware my power... Green Lantern's light!
ability.greenlantern.revoke_ring.descrip: Leaders only: take the ring from the nearest member of your corps.
ability.greenlantern.skill_empowered.des: Within 12 blocks of a Green Lantern your ring recharges fast and you hit harder. Costs 8 XP levels.
ability.greenlantern.green.skill_roar.de: Let out a roar that knocks back and weakens everything within 7 blocks. Costs 8 XP levels.
ability.greenlantern.green.skill_emerald: Ultimate: a blast of pure will that hurts and launches everything within 8 blocks. Costs 30 XP levels.
ability.greenlantern.spectrum_fusion.des: Wear two rings at once to fuse their powers. Each pair of corps has its own fusion.
oath.greenlantern.yellow.1: In blackest day, in brightest night,
oath.greenlantern.yellow.2: Beware your fears made into light.
oath.greenlantern.yellow.3: Let those who try to stop what's right,
oath.greenlantern.yellow.4: Burn like my power... Sinestro's might!
ability.greenlantern.yellow.skill_inflic: Fill everything within 10 blocks with terror: darkness, slowness and weakness. Costs 8 XP levels.
ability.greenlantern.yellow.skill_nightm: Show the nearest creature within 12 blocks its worst fear: blinded, dizzy and sluggish. Costs 12 XP levels.
ability.greenlantern.yellow.skill_fear_i: Ultimate: become terror itself, crippling everything within 12 blocks for 15 seconds. Costs 30 XP levels.
oath.greenlantern.red.1: With blood and rage of crimson red,
oath.greenlantern.red.2: Ripped from a corpse so freshly dead,
oath.greenlantern.red.4: We'll burn you all... that is your fate!
ability.greenlantern.red.skill_napalm.de: Spew burning blood plasma that sets targets on fire. Costs 8 XP levels.
ability.greenlantern.red.skill_rage.desc: Toggle: give in to your rage for Strength II and Speed. Drains charge. Costs 12 XP levels.
ability.greenlantern.red.skill_roar.desc: Let out a roar that knocks back and weakens everything within 7 blocks. Costs 16 XP levels.
ability.greenlantern.red.skill_blood_rag: Ultimate: a storm of rage that hurts, withers and burns everything within 8 blocks. Costs 30 XP levels.
ability.greenlantern.orange.skill_avaric: Passive: you mine much faster while suited up. Costs 5 XP levels.
MINE! Pull every item and experience orb within 16 blocks to you. Costs 8 XP levels.
ability.greenlantern.orange.skill_life_d: Steal the life of the nearest creature within 10 blocks to heal yourself. Costs 12 XP levels.
ability.greenlantern.orange.skill_greed_: Every mob you defeat while wearing the ring joins your hoard (up to 10). Summon the whole hoard as orange constructs that fight for you for 30 seconds. Costs 16 XP levels.
ability.greenlantern.orange.skill_consum: Ultimate: devour the life of everything within 8 blocks and keep it as extra hearts. Costs 30 XP levels.
oath.greenlantern.blue.1: In fearful day, in raging night,
oath.greenlantern.blue.2: With strong hearts full, our souls ignite,
oath.greenlantern.blue.3: When all seems lost in the War of Light,
oath.greenlantern.blue.4: Look to the stars... for hope burns bright!
ability.greenlantern.blue.skill_hope_aur: Toggle: you and every player within 8 blocks regenerate health. Drains charge. Costs 8 XP levels.
ability.greenlantern.blue.skill_rekindle: Restore hope to every player within 12 blocks: instant healing and extra hearts. Costs 12 XP levels.
ability.greenlantern.blue.skill_hope_bur: Ultimate: every player within 16 blocks is healed and gains Regeneration and Resistance for 20 seconds. Costs 30 XP levels.
oath.greenlantern.violet.1: For hearts long lost and full of fright,
oath.greenlantern.violet.2: For those alone in blackest night,
oath.greenlantern.violet.3: Accept our ring and join our fight,
oath.greenlantern.violet.4: Love conquers all... with violet light!
ability.greenlantern.violet.skill_crysta: Seal the nearest creature within 12 blocks in violet crystal for 8 seconds. Costs 8 XP levels.
ability.greenlantern.violet.skill_loves_: Heal every player within 8 blocks and give them Regeneration. Costs 12 XP levels.
Enchant everything within 10 blocks with love so it can barely hurt anyone. Costs 16 XP levels.
ability.greenlantern.violet.skill_love_c: Ultimate: fully heal every player within 16 blocks and pacify everything else around you. Costs 30 XP levels.
oath.greenlantern.indigo.2: Ak wo tauva, Ihla wo nauva,
Throw a bolt of indigo light and teleport to wherever it lands. Costs 8 XP levels.
ability.greenlantern.indigo.skill_compas: The nearest creature within 12 blocks feels the pain it causes and can barely fight for 10 seconds. Costs 12 XP levels.
ability.greenlantern.indigo.skill_healin: Heal every player within 6 blocks. Costs 16 XP levels.
ability.greenlantern.indigo.skill_staff_: Ultimate: everything within 12 blocks is overwhelmed by empathy and can barely fight for 15 seconds. Costs 30 XP levels.
ability.greenlantern.white.skill_life_gr: While crouching: bring the ground around you to life, turning dirt to grass and cobblestone to moss. Costs 8 XP levels.
ability.greenlantern.white.skill_life_au: Toggle: you and every player within 10 blocks regenerate health. Drains charge. Costs 12 XP levels.
ability.greenlantern.white.skill_entitys: Ultimate: a wave of pure life that heals every living thing within 12 blocks and burns the undead. Costs 30 XP levels.
oath.greenlantern.black.1: The Blackest Night falls from the skies,
oath.greenlantern.black.2: The darkness grows as all light dies,
oath.greenlantern.black.3: We crave your hearts and your demise,
oath.greenlantern.black.4: By my black hand, the dead shall rise!
ability.greenlantern.black.skill_heart_r: Tear at the heart of the nearest creature within 8 blocks, healing yourself. Costs 8 XP levels.
ability.greenlantern.black.skill_death_a: Toggle: everything within 6 blocks slowly withers. Drains charge. Costs 12 XP levels.
ability.greenlantern.black.skill_raise_d: Every mob you slay while wearing the ring can rise again (up to 10). Raise them all as Black Lantern revenants that fight for you for 30 seconds. Costs 16 XP levels.
ability.greenlantern.black.skill_undying: Passive: while your ring holds at least 500 charge, a killing blow leaves you standing instead. The ring spends all its charge to bring you back. Costs 20 XP levels.
ability.greenlantern.black.skill_emotion: Toggle: see every living thing within 32 blocks glowing through walls. Costs 8 XP levels.
ability.greenlantern.black.skill_blackes: Ultimate: plunge everything within 12 blocks into death: darkness, withering and pain. Costs 30 XP levels.
